description: Summary figure: role-class discriminators for S. pombe cmc4
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13,7.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,3, hspace=0.55, wspace=0.32)

sp="MVDCQKEACNLQSCIQRNQYNQGNCEKFVNDLLLCCKRWYDKNSLTGNEAPHTCPELKPLLRQLSSRNLT"

# --- panel 1: cmc4 domain cartoon with disulfides ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
ax.plot([1,70],[0,0],color="#cbd5e0",lw=7,solid_capstyle="butt")
for s,e,lab in [(4,20,"helix 1"),(22,44,"helix 2"),(50,69,"helix 3")]:
    ax.plot([s,e],[0,0],color="#2b6cb0",lw=12,solid_capstyle="butt")
    ax.text((s+e)/2,-0.42,lab,ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#2b6cb0")
cys=[4,9,14,25,35,36,54]
for c in cys:
    ax.plot(c,0,"o",ms=7,color="#c05621",zorder=5)
    ax.text(c,0.16,f"C{c}",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#c05621")
for a,b,col,lab in [(4,35,"#2f855a","SS"),(14,25,"#2f855a","SS"),(36,54,"#805ad5","SS")]:
    xm=(a+b)/2; h=0.55 if b-a>20 else 0.35
    t=np.linspace(0,np.pi,60)
    ax.plot(xm+(b-a)/2*np.cos(t), -h*np.sin(t)-0.08, color=col, lw=1.8)
ax.text(19,-0.72,"C4-C35 and C14-C25: twin-CX9C CHCH disulfides",fontsize=8,color="#2f855a")
ax.text(19,-0.88,"C36-C54: third disulfide stapling helix 3 (as in p8MTCP1 C39-C50)",fontsize=8,color="#805ad5")
ax.annotate("C9: only free thiol\nnearest 2nd ligand 9.0 A away\n(no copper site)",xy=(9,0),xytext=(14,0.95),
            fontsize=8,color="#9b2c2c",arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#9b2c2c",lw=1.1))
ax.annotate("DLLL: Mia40 docking bed\n(KD +1.97 / +3.47)",xy=(33,0),xytext=(44,0.95),
            fontsize=8,color="#2c5282",arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#2c5282",lw=1.1))
ax.set_xlim(-2,74); ax.set_ylim(-1.1,1.35); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("S. pombe cmc4 (G2TRJ8, 70 aa): AlphaFold topology, pLDDT 89.6",fontsize=11,loc="left")

# --- panel 2: role-class scorecard ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
crit=["twin-CX9C\nCHCH fold","Mia40 docking\nbed","free Cu-thiolate\ncluster","CCxC motif\n(family-wide)","COX-restricted\nphylogeny"]
cu   =[1,0,0,0,1]; relay=[1,1,0,0,0]; cox=[1,0,0,0,1]
obs  =[1,1,0,0,0]
M=np.array([obs]).T
ax.imshow(np.array([[1],[1],[0],[0],[0]]),cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
for i,c in enumerate(crit):
    ax.text(0,i,"present" if obs[i] else "absent",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_yticks(range(5)); ax.set_yticklabels(crit,fontsize=8); ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_title("cmc4: observed features",fontsize=10)

# --- panel 3: CCxC copper motif, family-wide ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.bar(["CMC4\nn=1922","COX17\nn=3000"],[0.1,97.3],color=["#2b6cb0","#c05621"],width=.55)
for x,v in zip([0,1],[0.1,97.3]): ax.text(x,v+3,f"{v:.1f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% members with CCxC Cu(I) motif"); ax.set_ylim(0,112)
ax.set_title("Copper motif is family-defining\nfor COX17, absent from CMC4",fontsize=10)

# --- panel 4: free-thiol ligand geometry ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
names=["S. pombe\ncmc4","S. pombe\ncox17","S. cerevisiae\nCox17"]
dist=[9.0,3.59,3.92]
cols=["#9b2c2c","#2f855a","#2f855a"]
ax.bar(names,dist,color=cols,width=.55)
ax.axhspan(0,5,color="#2f855a",alpha=0.12)
ax.text(1.5,4.3,"Cu(I) bonding range",fontsize=8,color="#2f855a",ha="center")
for x,v in zip(range(3),dist): ax.text(x,v+0.25,f"{v:.2f} A",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("distance, free Cys SG to nearest 2nd ligand (A)")
ax.set_title("cmc4 has no free-thiolate pair",fontsize=10)

# --- panel 5: structural match ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
ax.bar(["vs human CMC4\n(1HP8, NMR)","vs apo Cox17\n(1U97, NMR)"],[58/70*100,41/70*100],color=["#2b6cb0","#c05621"],width=.55)
for x,v in zip([0,1],[58/70*100,41/70*100]): ax.text(x,v+2,f"{v:.0f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% cmc4 residues within 4 A of target CA"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("AlphaFold cmc4 superposes on CMC4,\nnot on Cox17",fontsize=10)

fig.suptitle("S. pombe cmc4 is a Mia40-imported CHCH structural protein, not a copper metallochaperone",
             fontsize=13, y=0.985)
plt.show()
